reviewNotes: ERP and measured-pagination reconciliation: current digests include prior-certified claim bases plus measured Unicode/DOM-Range fragments, atomic cell conservation, complete semantic row-continuation validation, active-table budgets and scoped physical n-up geometry. Raw PCAR and canonical settlement APIs are print projections, not new agent financial or ERP authority. Existing grants, privacy and CA-04/CA-05 decisions remain unchanged. Schema/acceptance/renderer dependencies are actual transitive changes; verification and limits are recorded in docs/ERP_PRINT_AUDIT.zh-CN.md and docs/ERP_COMPLEX_PAGINATION.zh-CN.md. This is not a published baseline, Production Ready declaration or hardware certification.

New read-only semantic observation service with host-minted, document/revision/content/run/policy-bound authorization. Projects only authorized text/assigned bindings and host-permitted synthetic values, selected targets and real numeric print evidence. Pixels remain blocked. Positive and rejection/recovery fixtures inspect actual outgoing provider bodies and refresh-time guards. The existing items row-fill operation now calls the same pure tableStyleChange service as the real inspector. Its six-digit hex/null schema and effect contract stay at 1.0.0; canonical service errors and normalized candidate/binding diagnostics agree. Pi schema, read-only grants, selected scopes and private proposal approval remain independently enforced. Differential fixtures cover fill/reset, invalid inputs, atomic candidate rejection and recovery; recorded browser requests verify the actual transport path.

The heading/page-number operation and real inspector now reuse elementStyleChange. Typography bounds, closed keys, value spelling and replacement semantics stay typed under 1.0.0. Empty overrides normalize to removal/inheritance in both paths, avoiding a spurious empty-object proposal. Identical defined key/value overrides retain their existing representation, so JSON key order alone reports NO_CHANGES. Added versioned examples cover page-number typography and inherited NO_CHANGES. Direct differential fixtures cover normalized candidates, existing validation, identical service errors, selected/read-only denial, private-batch recovery and separate human approval; browser fixtures record the real provider transport.

CA-05 slice 3 introduces versioned receipt-bound retrieval under explicit single-run fictional pixel and existing text/value authority. The qualified sandbox DOM raster bridge preserves project isolation. Run-owned PNG bytes are validated, hashed and paired with the actual tool call/result on the outgoing wire, including after compaction. Negative/recovery fixtures cover stale/revoked grants, denied values/assets, bounds, byte limits and unsupported modalities. This does not qualify final visual comparison, real-data publication or sensitive assets. The existing default-off permission labels now share a bounded scroll area so they cannot collapse selected element references in the fixed composer. Checkbox IDs, exact labels, defaults and grant policy remain unchanged. The native fixture measures desktop/mobile references, permission scrolling, comment/input controls and close/reopen without provider inference; CSS and the fixture now participate in release identity.
